releaseTitle: ATalk v3.12.0 — 8 Master Core Upgrades: Granular Screenshot Sentinel, Per-Chat Themes, Multi-Pin Carousel, Reaction Bursts, Universal Search, Storage Studio, In-Call Screen Sharing, Live Location Radar
releaseNotes:
• 01 Screenshot & Screen Recording Detection Sentinel (Full User Control): Granular privacy controls allowing user to set capture policy per conversation (ALLOW, BLOCK via hardware Android FLAG_SECURE window shielding, or ALERT ONLY). Integrates Android 14+ ScreenCaptureCallback and pre-Android 14 ContentObserver with real-time in-chat cryptographic warning alert broadcast.
• 02 Per-Chat Custom Theme & Wallpaper Styling: Configure unique color palettes and wallpapers per conversation. Allows toggling 'Apply to this chat only' or globally, with 1-tap reset to global defaults.
• 03 Multi-Message Pin Stack & Chronological Pin Carousel: Pin unlimited messages per conversation with a Telegram-style cycling carousel header showing (i/N), animated smooth jump-and-glow, and dedicated PinnedMessagesDialog to preview all pinned items chronologically.
• 04 Interactive Full-Screen Reaction Bursts & Physics Emojis: High-framerate Canvas particle physics simulation for ❤️, 🔥, 🎉, 🚀, ⚡, 👏, 💯 synchronized in real-time across peer devices over Supabase Realtime WebSocket events.
• 05 Unified Universal Search & Media Gallery Tab Filter: Six segmented tabs [All, Chats, Media, Links, Files, Voice Notes] with calendar Date Jump picker, inline link opening, document attachments, and voice notes.
• 06 Visual Granular Storage Analyzer & Auto-Purge Cache Studio: Multi-segment storage visualization, per-chat disk footprint calculations with selective 1-tap media purging, auto-purge retention rules (Immediate, 3 Days, 1 Week, 1 Month, Indefinitely), and 1-tap RAM cache shredder.
• 07 In-Call Encrypted Screen Sharing: P2P high-framerate screen broadcasting during calls via Agora RTC screen capture engine and Android MediaProjection.
• 08 Encrypted Live Location Radar & Proximity Ping: Tactical real-time radar sweep canvas with concentric range rings, rotating beam sweep, distance telemetry, and proximity alert when peer is within 100 meters.
